implemented_requirements.requirement: Two-player vertical paddles with up/down controls
implemented_requirements.evidence: Paddle class creates a rectangle; Game.__init__ binds keys w/s for left paddle and Up/Down for right paddle; update() moves paddles based on self.keys.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Ball bounces between paddles and off top/bottom edges
implemented_requirements.evidence: In Game.update() the ball position is updated and collisions with top/bottom are handled (y1 <= 0, y2 >= HEIGHT) and paddle collisions are detected and reflected.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Players score a point when the opponent misses the ball
implemented_requirements.evidence: If x2 < 0 the right player scores (award_point(1)); if x1 > WIDTH the left player scores (award_point(0)).
WIN_SCORE = 5; award_point() sets self.winner when self.scores[player] >= WIN_SCORE.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Reset the ball after each point
implemented_requirements.evidence: award_point() calls self.ball.reset() and sets self.serve_delay = SERVE_FRAMES to pause before the next serve.

judge.summary: The provided code implements a functional two‑player Pong game with vertical paddles, proper ball physics, scoring, a win condition, and ball reset after each point. All core requirements are satisfied and the program appears ready to run with Tkinter.
